paragraphs: BECS Technology builds electronic controllers, starting with water chemistry and filtration controls used on swimming pools, water parks, spas and splash pads. A second line goes into pork and poultry barns, where the company says its products help assure livestock health. A third covers refrigeration, with controls that supermarkets, convenience stores and liquor stores use to hold groceries at temperature.

A water chemistry controller watches the pool continuously and decides when the water needs attention. Operators reach those controllers through an online service the company describes as simple and secure. On the livestock side, the systems track feed inventory across a farm and send real-time data back to feed mills.

The company was incorporated in 1991. Its original ownership group has remained unchanged and has been together for over 30 years. More than 50,000 controllers have been designed and manufactured over that period. All manufacturing is performed onsite at a facility in Saint Louis, Missouri. The BECSys line of water treatment controllers was introduced in 2005. Before that, many products were marketed and distributed under the names of partner organizations.

quote.text: BECSys water chemistry and filtration controls keep recreational water beautiful and safe throughout the world.
